audience: support teams that answer customer tickets and manage requesters and agents in Octadesk

useCases.title: Search tickets and read one ticket
useCases.text: Search tickets with optional filters and read the page of results. Open one ticket by its number to read its fields and status.

useCases.title: Read a ticket conversation in order
useCases.text: Open one ticket by its number. List its replies, internal notes and property changes, in order.

useCases.title: Find a requester and list their tickets
useCases.text: Find a person by exact e-mail address, or search requesters by e-mail or name. List the tickets of that requester.

useCases.title: Open a new ticket for a requester
useCases.text: Create a ticket with a summary, requester, group, assignee, priority and tags. Add an internal note for agents, or a public reply the requester can read.

useCases.title: Change the status, priority or assignee of a ticket
useCases.text: Update only the fields that change on one ticket, such as status, priority, assignee or group. A public comment is e-mailed to the requester.

useCases.title: Create or correct a requester or agent record
useCases.text: Create a person with an e-mail address and a name. Update the fields of an existing person, and send only the fields that change.
